As a Warehouse Packing Employee, you make sure that outgoing orders leave the warehouse accurately checked, properly packed, and on time. You kick off your shift by reviewing the daily order queue and setting up your packing station with boxes, tape, and protective fillers. Throughout the day, you check picked items against order specifications, scan barcodes into the system, and package products securely to prevent transit damage. You end your shift by handing over prepared pallets and parcels to the transport team and leaving your packing station clean for the next shift. In this temporary role, you work via Staffice at our client's warehouse.
